sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Empire stretched from Hindukush to Mysore.
  • Key centres: Pataliputra, Taxila, Ujjain, Tosali, Suvarnagiri.

Personalities

  • Upagupta (Monk)
  • Mahendra & Sanghamitra (Missionaries)
  • Radhagupta (Minister)

Core Concepts

  • Dhamma Policy: A socio-ethical code, not a state religion. Focus on tolerance, respect for elders, and non-violence.
  • Administrative Reforms: Appointment of Dhamma-mahamatras to maintain moral order.
